$comment: The note workflow, shared by the frontend and the backend. Both implement these rules from this file and are tested against note-workflow.cases.json. After changing a rule, regenerate the cases (see export-workflow-cases.ts).

messages.notAllowed: {trigger} is not allowed while the note is {status}.

$guardsComment: Checks run in this order: roles, then reviewer ownership, then the remaining conditions in the order listed. A trigger without a guard (system events) has no extra checks. reviewer: 'assigned' = the actor must be the assigned reviewer; 'unassignedOrAssigned' = no reviewer yet, or the actor.

messages.role: Only a Clinician or an Administrator can regenerate a note.
Only a Reviewer can start a review.
messages.reviewer: This note is assigned to another reviewer.

messages.role: Only a Reviewer can return a note to the queue.
messages.reviewer: Only the assigned reviewer can return this note.

messages.role: Only a Reviewer can approve a note.
messages.reviewer: Only the assigned reviewer can approve this note.
messages.mfa: MFA re-authentication is required to approve this note.

messages.role: Only a Reviewer can reject a note.
messages.reviewer: Only the assigned reviewer can reject this note.

messages.role: Only a Clinician can resubmit a note.
messages.content: All SOAP content must be completed before resubmission.

messages.role: Only a Clinician or an Administrator can amend an approved note.
messages.approvalMissing: The note does not have an approval timestamp.

$contentEditingComment: Who may edit SOAP content, checked in this order: denied roles, the locked status, then the actor's role rule. A role with no rule is denied with the default message.

deniedRoles.READONLY_AUDITOR: Read-only auditors cannot edit note content.

REVIEWER.statusMessage: Reviewers can edit only notes that are in review.
REVIEWER.assignedReviewerMessage: Only the assigned reviewer can edit this note.

CLINICIAN.statusMessage: Clinicians can edit rejected or amended notes.

ADMIN.statusMessage: Administrators can edit only active review, rejected, or amended notes.

contentEditing.defaultMessage: You are not authorized to edit this note.

reviewerAssignment.roleMessage: Only a Clinician or an Administrator can assign reviewers.
reviewerAssignment.statusMessage: Reviewer assignment is available only for notes that are ready for review or amended.

regeneration.statusMessage: Only failed notes can be regenerated.
